classification: Engineering lifetime defect repair; no formulas, floating-point order, numerical selection or acceptance-policy changes.
findings: Default destructor reverses declared vectors: elements before nodes. Default move assignment assigns vectors in declaration order: nodes before elements.
Production searches found pointer construction/adoption of TriangleAdaptive and SubMesh, no direct value-copy/move uses. Static search is not compiler-level alias proof.

ReplaceNode occurs only in its declaration and definition in current tracked first-party sources/tests; it rewires pointers without updating adjacency. Implicit triangle copy/move and protected vertex mutation remain unaudited external API risks.

TriangleAdaptive ordinary destructor is empty. A completed triangle can leave expired node observers; automatic deregistration is deferred until triangle special-member and replacement semantics are designed and qualified.
Patch stores non-owning SubMesh observers; moving does not automatically rebind either object address.
Estimator hidden/duplicate root ownership and full-process/parallel memory remain open.
